target_customer: AI teams running self hosted inference on their own GPUs
problem: Default serving engines are inefficient for specific workloads, raising GPU cost.
business_model: Performance based service: pay only if agreed performance target is met

founders.name: Zakaria El hjouji
founders.background_notes: Seven years on pricing algorithms at Uber; sold a software product during grad school.

technical_complexity.rationale: Workload profiling and custom kernel and engine tuning for vLLM and SGLang.

defensibility.rationale: Services style optimization depends on team skill; open engines improve fast.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: SGLang spun out as RadixArk in January 2026, a sign of commercial attention.

market_need_then: GPU costs for inference are large; company reports saving teams over $5M (unverified).

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; the YC listed product also appears to describe real time video AI, which may confuse.

outcome_analysis: Overshoot is a YC Winter 2026 company, too young for an outcome. Press describes inference optimization savings by the company's own claim, while some profiles describe a real time vision platform, which suggests an earlier or parallel product. Funding is unverified.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked lists $500K pre-seed from YC and Pioneer Fund; Preqin lists an undisclosed Pioneer Fund seed on 2026-03-19. No rounds recorded.
